verses.original: Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις Διασπορᾶς Πόντου Γαλατίας Καππαδοκίας Ἀσίας καὶ Βιθυνίας
verses.transliteration: Petros apostolos Iēsou Christou Eklektois parepidēmois Diasporas Pontou Galatias Kappadokias Asias kai Bithynias
verses.literal: Peter an apostle of Jesus Christ To [the] elect who are exiles of [the] Dispersion [throughout] Pontus Galatia Cappadocia Asia and Bithynia, [chosen]

verses.original: κατὰ πρόγνωσιν Θεοῦ Πατρός ἁγιασμῷ ἐν Πνεύματος εἰς ὑπακοὴν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πληθυνθείη
verses.transliteration: kata prognōsin Theou Patros hagiasmō en Pneumatos eis hypakoēn Iēsou Christou kai rhantismon haimatos Charis kai eirēnē hymin plēthyntheiē
verses.literal: according to [the] foreknowledge of God [the] Father [and] sanctified by [the] Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by [His] blood Grace and peace be yours in abundance

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ αὐτοῦ πολὺ τὸ ἔλεος ὁ ἡμᾶς ἀναγεννήσας εἰς ζῶσαν ἐλπίδα δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Eulogētos ho Theos kai Patēr hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kata autou poly to eleos ho hēmas anagennēsas eis zōsan elpida di’ anastaseōs Iēsou Christou ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our - Lord Jesus Christ By His great - mercy [He] vvv has given us new birth into a living hope through [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ from [the] dead

verses.original: εἰς κληρονομίαν ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: eis klēronomian aphtharton kai amianton kai amaranton tetērēmenēn en ouranois eis hymas
verses.literal: [and] into an inheritance [that is] imperishable - undefiled and unfading reserved in heaven for you

verses.original: τοὺς διὰ πίστεως φρουρουμένους ἐν Θεοῦ δυνάμει εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι ἐν ἐσχάτῳ καιρῷ
verses.transliteration: tous dia pisteōs phrouroumenous en Theou dynamei eis sōtērian hetoimēn apokalyphthēnai en eschatō kairō
verses.literal: who through faith [are] shielded by God’s power for [the] salvation [that is] ready to be revealed in [the] last time

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε εἰ ἄρτι ὀλίγον ἐστὶν δέον λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς
verses.transliteration: en hō agalliasthe ei arti oligon estin deon lypēthentes en poikilois peirasmois
verses.literal: In this you greatly rejoice though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου δὲ δοκιμαζομένου διὰ πυρὸς εὑρεθῇ εἰς ἔπαινον καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina to dokimion hymōn tēs pisteōs polytimoteron chrysiou tou apollymenou de dokimazomenou dia pyros heurethē eis epainon kai doxan kai timēn en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that the proven character of your - faith more precious than gold which perishes even though refined by fire may result in . . . praise - glory and honor at [the] revelation of Jesus Christ

verses.original: οὐκ ἰδόντες ὃν ἀγαπᾶτε μὴ ὁρῶντες ὃν ἄρτι πιστεύοντες εἰς δὲ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ χαρᾷ
verses.transliteration: ouk idontes hon agapate mē horōntes hon arti pisteuontes eis de agalliasthe aneklalētō kai dedoxasmenē chara
verses.literal: vvv [Though] you have not seen [Him] you love [Him] vvv [and though] you do not see [Him] now you believe in [Him] and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy

verses.original: κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν
verses.transliteration: komizomenoi to telos tēs hymōn pisteōs sōtērian psychōn
verses.literal: [now that] you are receiving the goal of your faith [the] salvation of [your] souls

verses.original: Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας προφῆται οἱ προφητεύσαντες περὶ τῆς χάριτος εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν
verses.transliteration: Peri hēs sōtērias prophētai hoi prophēteusantes peri tēs charitos eis hymas exezētēsan kai exēraunēsan
verses.literal: Concerning this salvation [the] prophets who foretold . . . the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully

verses.original: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν τὸ Πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐδήλου προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ παθήματα εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ τὰς δόξας μετὰ ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: eraunōntes eis tina ē poion kairon to Pneuma Christou en autois edēlou promartyromenon ta pathēmata eis Christon kai tas doxas meta tauta
verses.literal: trying to determine . . . the time and setting . . . . . . . . . to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories vvv to follow

verses.original: ἀπεκαλύφθη οἷς ὅτι οὐχ διηκόνουν ἑαυτοῖς δὲ ὑμῖν αὐτά ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ὑμᾶς ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι ἀποσταλέντι ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἄγγελοι ἐπιθυμοῦσιν παρακύψαι εἰς ἃ
verses.transliteration: apekalyphthē hois hoti ouch diēkonoun heautois de hymin auta ha nyn anēngelē hymin dia tōn euangelisamenōn hymas en Hagiō Pneumati apostalenti ap’ ouranou angeloi epithymousin parakypsai eis ha
verses.literal: It was revealed to [them] that vvv they were not serving themselves but you [when they foretold] the things - vvv now announced - by those who preached the gospel to you by [the] Holy Spirit sent from heaven [Even] angels long to look into [these things]

verses.original: Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς ὑμῶν διανοίας νήφοντες ἐλπίσατε τελείως ἐπὶ τὴν χάριν φερομένην ὑμῖν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Dio anazōsamenoi tas osphyas tēs hymōn dianoias nēphontes elpisate teleiōs epi tēn charin pheromenēn hymin en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Therefore prepare . . . . . . . . . your minds {for action} Be sober-minded Set [your] hope fully on the grace to be given you at [the] revelation of Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὡς ὑπακοῆς τέκνα μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις ἐν ὑμῶν πρότερον τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ
verses.transliteration: hōs hypakoēs tekna mē syschēmatizomenoi tais epithymiais en hymōn proteron tē agnoia
verses.literal: As obedient children vvv do not conform to the passions of your former - ignorance

verses.original: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον καὶ αὐτοὶ γενήθητε ἅγιοι ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ
verses.transliteration: alla kata ton kalesanta hymas hagion kai autoi genēthēte hagioi en pasē anastrophē
verses.literal: But just as He who called you [is] holy so - be holy in all you do

verses.original: διότι γέγραπται ὅτι ἔσεσθε Ἅγιοι ὅτι ἐγὼ εἰμι ἅγιος
verses.transliteration: dioti gegraptai hoti esesthe Hagioi hoti egō eimi hagios
verses.literal: for it is written - Be holy because I am holy

verses.original: Καὶ εἰ ἐπικαλεῖσθε Πατέρα τὸν κρίνοντα κατὰ ἑκάστου τὸ ἔργον ἀπροσωπολήμπτως ἀναστράφητε ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς ὑμῶν χρόνον παροικίας
verses.transliteration: Kai ei epikaleisthe Patera ton krinonta kata hekastou to ergon aprosōpolēmptōs anastraphēte en phobō ton tēs hymōn chronon paroikias
verses.literal: - Since you call on [a] Father who judges - each one’s - work impartially conduct yourselves in reverent fear during - your stay as foreigners

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι οὐ φθαρτοῖς ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ ἐλυτρώθητε ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ἀναστροφῆς ὑμῶν πατροπαραδότου
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti ou phthartois argyriō ē chrysiō elytrōthēte ek tēs mataias anastrophēs hymōn patroparadotou
verses.literal: [For] you know that vvv it was not with perishable things [such as] silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι Χριστοῦ ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου
verses.transliteration: alla timiō haimati Christou hōs amnou amōmou kai aspilou
verses.literal: but with [the] precious blood of Christ - a lamb without blemish [or] spot

verses.original: μὲν προεγνωσμένου πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου δὲ φανερωθέντος ἐπ’ τῶν ἐσχάτου χρόνων δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: men proegnōsmenou pro katabolēs kosmou de phanerōthentos ep’ tōn eschatou chronōn di’ hymas
verses.literal: - He was known before [the] foundation of [the] world but was revealed in the last times for your sake . . .

verses.original: δι’ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πιστοὺς εἰς Θεὸν τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόντα δόξαν αὐτῷ ὥστε ὑμῶν τὴν πίστιν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς Θεόν
verses.transliteration: di’ autou tous pistous eis Theon ton egeiranta auton ek nekrōn kai donta doxan autō hōste hymōn tēn pistin kai elpida einai eis Theon
verses.literal: Through Him [you] believe in God who raised Him . . . from [the] dead and vvv glorified Him and so your - faith and hope are in God

verses.original: ἡγνικότες ὑμῶν Τὰς ψυχὰς ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ἀγαπήσατε ἀλλήλους ἐκτενῶς ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: hēgnikotes hymōn Tas psychas en tē hypakoē tēs alētheias eis philadelphian anypokriton agapēsate allēlous ektenōs ek katharas kardias
verses.literal: [Since] you have purified your - souls by - obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers . . . love one another deeply from a pure heart

verses.original: ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ φθαρτῆς σπορᾶς ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου διὰ ζῶντος καὶ μένοντος λόγου Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: anagegennēmenoi ouk ek phthartēs sporas alla aphthartou dia zōntos kai menontos logou Theou
verses.literal: For you have been born again not of perishable seed but of imperishable through [the] living and enduring word of God

verses.original: διότι Πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος καὶ πᾶσα αὐτῆς δόξα ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου ὁ χόρτος ἐξηράνθη καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν
verses.transliteration: dioti Pasa sarx hōs chortos kai pasa autēs doxa hōs anthos chortou ho chortos exēranthē kai to anthos exepesen
verses.literal: For All flesh [is] like grass and all its glory like [the] flowers of the field the grass withers and the flowers fall

verses.original: δὲ τὸ ῥῆμα Κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα δέ Τοῦτο ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de to rhēma Kyriou menei eis ton aiōna de Touto estin to rhēma to euangelisthen eis hymas
verses.literal: but the word of [the] Lord stands vvv vvv forever And this is the word that was proclaimed to you
